files are found like game resources: a file only inside a startup-list archive (sResourceStartUpArchiveList) is read; with a loose copy and a copy in the plugin's own '- Main.ba2', the loose copy is used

a file must start with the UTF-16LE BOM; otherwise F4SE logs 'BOM Error, file must be encoded in UCS-2 LE.' after 'Reading translations from Interface\Translations\<file>...' and skips it (UTF-8 with or without BOM, UTF-16 without BOM)

line based: a line ends at LF (CR before it dropped, a lone CR is text) or after 511 UTF-16 units; it needs a leading '$' and a TAB; key = text before the last TAB, value = text after (empty allowed, trailing spaces kept); lines without TAB or '$' are skipped
